svg.text: Every screen is made of these parts and nothing else (ui-guide.md, section 11).
A screen's one main action. One per screen. Its picture and one or two words.
Any other action: round, a small icon, one word under it.
A way to somewhere: a rounded square, never round. The current one is lit.
One thing in a list. The selected row is lit and carries Go.
The frame's title in the thing's color. Two meet when one belongs to the other.
One fact with a number. A label of ten letters at most.
A bar for an amount, a ring for time. Lavender; pink only when it needs you.
True things are flat. Names go somewhere. Dashes mean "not there yet".
Small capitals and a rule. Five to a screen at most.
Nothing under 11 px (12 on a phone). Four sizes to a screen.
A color or a line style means one thing, everywhere.
Needs you: a signature, a failure, a siege.
Not there yet. (A siege keeps its pink dashes.)
A card, big: the thing's frame and color, its picture, then sections.
the main action: bottom left, nearest your hand
